about.name: javier
bio: Welcome to my page! I am an entrepreneur & software engineer with expertise in building innovative digital solutions. I combine technical skills with product development to create solutions for real-world problems.

With experience in both startups and established companies, I have developed a keen eye for identifying opportunities and turning them into successful ventures. My technical background allows me to understand the complexities of development, while my entrepreneurial mindset helps me see the bigger picture.

I am constantly learning and exploring new technologies to stay ahead of the curve. When I am not building and realising ideas, you will find me playing floorball, traveling, or trying something new and exciting.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
experience.description: Shipped critical features for byteplus.com including AI Playground 1.0 with configurable menus & Contact Sales forms, impacting the lead pipeline for 1000+ B2B clients. Re-architected the header from hardcoded TSX to a config-driven i18n system, drastically reducing deployment time. Optimized the conversion funnel with redirects, navigation structuring, and backwards-compatible deployments.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
experience.description: Forward deployed to co-engineer a B2G military personnel RBAC system for 65k+ DAU. Built a Lambda-automated batch pipeline for event and visitor retry management using Node.js workers, integrating FALCON & Sequelize for clearance and AWS SNS/SES/SQS for notifications. Automated end-to-end on/offboarding with real-time cross-system validation, reducing manual data entry by 80%.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineering Intern
experience.description: Shipped 20+ features and hotfixes for Malaysia's #1 arts ticketing platform under C-Suite supervision. Contributed to AI semantic search & recommendations using vector embeddings. Launched knowledgebase.cloudjoi.com from 0→1 using Next.js and RESTful APIs. Deployed ticket check-in/out system with queue-based email notifications and Redis caching.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant for CS1010X: Programming Methodology
experience.description: Given sole responsibility of rebuilding lesson materials and assignment files. Updated deprecated content from Python 3.7 to 3.13, improving GUI and translating code from Cocos to Pygame, utilising GIMPS to rectify faulty sRGB profiles, removing problematic metadata. 2D Runes Contest Head IC.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant for SWS3001: Solving Real World Problems with Computational Thinking
experience.description: SWS3001 is a course under the NUS School of Computing Summer Workshop, an annual program designed for undergraduate students in fields like Computer Science. It is a project-based, hands-on course aimed at equipping participants with knowledge on how to solve problems computationally. Mentored a class of 20+ Y3 International students, conducted tutorials and graded projects and presentations.

experience.title: AI Researcher
experience.description: Research attachment at Singapore's leading research organisation to enhance PCR result detection Extracted and analysed datasets via Matplotlib, NumPy, & pandas, and used EMA to determine sigmoidal curves from plot points and establish thresholds.
